ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels across approx 85% of visible surface, with 15% mid-to-high intensity grey and white pixels primarily localized on the distal right lobe.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced vertical folding/curling of the left lobe (image left) relative to the horizontal plane of the right lobe.
